MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The lens case feels like a useful follow-up to my recent lens cap and earlier camera supports because it would help protect equipment I already use, provided my lens fits.",
    "Spare camera batteries fit my interest in keeping devices powered and ready, although I would need to confirm that these batteries fit my camera."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The security camera serves a different purpose from my photography accessories; buying tripods and a lens cap does not mean I want outdoor surveillance.",
    "The projector screen assumes a setup I have not shown a need for. Owning a DVD player and television does not make a screen useful without a projector.",
    "The tablet kneeboard relates to my tablet purchases, but it holds the tablet differently from the stands and tripod mounts I have chosen.",
    "The sports earbuds, graphics card holder, keyboard, and router do not solve a need evident in my recent purchases. I would need a specific reason to add or replace that equipment."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of electronics seem to have been treated as interest in almost any electronic device, even though I repeatedly choose accessories with a particular practical use.",
    "Shared words such as camera, tablet, or video seem to carry too much weight when the actual purpose or setup differs from mine."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory card, card holder, reader, cable, and charging purchases suggest that supporting equipment I already own matters to me.",
    "My latest lens cap purchase makes lens care and protection particularly relevant, but fit still matters; it does not establish my camera model or battery type.",
    "I have bought devices alongside related accessories, such as the Fire tablet with a memory card and folio stand, so a clear connection to equipment I own helps make a recommendation useful."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in useful camera accessories but stretch my electronics purchases into unrelated equipment and uses."
}
